known_limitations: The visualization intentionally shows only explicit capability dependency metadata and explicit dependency graph relationships; it does not infer hidden dependencies.
External dependency references are displayed as unresolved external nodes until authoritative capability registry records exist.
No governance files, ledger, or devlog were modified.
summary: Implemented a read-only capability dependency visualization layer for Mission Control and architectural review, backed by the Estate Capability Registry and explicit dependency graph metadata, with graceful partial/missing dependency handling, authoritative source links, JSON/Markdown outputs, CLI access, Operations Center integration, and tests.
